Title: Sengir Dagger and 2 hand damage vamps.

Messages.Author: dabbler
Messages.Body: If a two hand damage vamp uses the dagger the dagger is that damage agg?

Messages.Author: self biased
Messages.Body:
i believe all of the vampires that were originally printed "2 hand damage" have since been errata'd to "+1 Strength," so yes. A Vampire with +1 Strength striking with a Sengir Dagger will do two aggravated damage.

www.secretlibrary.info/ is a great resource for looking up current card texts, as well as the cardlists in the download section here at VEKN.net.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Some vampires have X strength, not +Y strength, eg. Call the Great Beast has 4 strength, or a vampire playing Torn Signpost has 2 or 3 strength.

Anyway, it doesn't change the result.

Name: Sengir Dagger
Cardtype: Equipment
Cost: 2 pool
Unique melee weapon.
Strike: strength aggravated damage.

If a vampire with 2 strength strikes with the Sengir Dagger, the strike deals 2 aggravated damage.
